items.html: And behold, in these three vessels there are within them the NRN of the externality, as mentioned. Also, there are in them the aspects of inner light and surrounding light, in the secret of the Tzelem, as is known. Also, there are in them double lights, which are the Tzelem of Aba and Ima. And all this is called the externality of the worlds. And corresponding to them there are likewise three inner vessels of the souls, and within them the NRN of the internality of the souls, and there are in them inner light, surrounding light, and doubles, in the aspect of the Tzelem of Aba and Ima, in exactly the manner stated above, and they are all internal.
